ValidationRule.description: R-PM11: only the project owner or Projects Admin approves or rejects.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Rejected")), Project__r.OwnerId <> $User.Id, NOT($Permission.Projects_Manage))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the project's owner or a Projects admin can approve or reject hours.
